friction_and_reuse_candidates.reuse_candidate: Document config/weight identity hash as recommended common.model representation; keep raw native config in actual environment metadata.

reference_independence_review.finding: The equal-input reference is independent of captured native gradients and stored updates.
basis: Each reference forward/backward, gradient export and its own SGD optimizer step execute before trainer.train().
The reference optimizer is deleted, gradients are cleared, and each parameter is restored from pre-reference clones with exact equality asserted before native training.
Collection scripts only save captured gradient/update arrays; they do not load native gradient/update captures into the reference.

Corrected TRL sample order was informed by native sampler behavior from the superseded attempt; the final reference and native forward input_ids, labels and attention_mask are explicitly asserted equal.
LLaMAFactory and ms-swift selected captures disable native shuffling and preserve fixed collated inputs.
shared_components: Hugging Face model forward and shifted cross-entropy loss implementation
Native collator/template used to prepare the fixed common batch
The same model object is used sequentially after exact parameter restoration; separate backward/optimizer execution.
reference_independence_review.scope_limit: Independent execution/data flow, not an independent mathematical implementation of the model or loss. Shared implementation errors can agree on both sides.

native_entrypoint_scope.trl: trl.trainer.sft_trainer.SFTTrainer.train() with native language-model collator on pretokenized fixed samples.
native_entrypoint_scope.llamafactory: llamafactory.train.sft.trainer.CustomSeq2SeqTrainer.train() component with native SFTDataCollatorWith4DAttentionMask and default template. Full LLaMAFactory run_sft workflow, model loading workflow, CLI and raw-text dataset preprocessing were not exercised.
native_entrypoint_scope.swift: swift.trainers.Seq2SeqTrainer.train() component with native template/data_collator on fixed tokens. Full SwiftSft CLI/pipeline and raw-text preprocessing were not exercised.

replay.artifact_dependent_full_comparison_repla: Requires original local NPY arrays, retained hashes, compatible runtime and model resources. NPY/tensor/model/optimizer weight payloads are excluded.
replay.native_training_rerun: Requires model weights/tokenizer resources, compatible dependencies/GPU, repository integration and replacing redacted path placeholders; this archive alone is insufficient.
replay.auditable_without_arrays: Selected parameter-level comparison metrics/coverage, target scores, 24 recorded validation results, masks/labels, trainer settings, source pins and source data flow.
replay.portable_target_score_recomputation: Included score contracts/manifests/environment/status and toolchain allow recomputing the six selected target-score reports; this is narrower than tensor replay or native training.

historical_provisional_status_note: Superseded raw summary.json precision_status fields were written before guarding comparator status and are provisional. The selected mapping plus selected comparison/validation reports are authoritative. Preserved raw statuses are not acceptance claims.
